thread:
emma_revenue: Heads up - Customer: MedCore renewal invoice INV-2025-0017 shows an unexpected 'Private Platform Expansion' line of $40,000 and support moved to Enterprise. Contract (MedCore_SOW_2023_final) shows Platform $95k and Support = Standard $18k. No executed amendment.

jorge_sales: Can you attach the invoice lines? I pulled the PDF and see: 
``
Line 5: Platform fee - Private - $95,000
Line 6: Private Platform Expansion - $40,000
Line 12: Support - Enterprise - $60,000
Total: $195,000
``
kelly_legal: Quick check: CLM indicates quote EXP-2024-07 but status = quoted, not signed. No countersignature or PO.

ben_billing: Invoice went out 2025-02-01, billing contact billing@medcore.org. I've flagged it in the billing queue and put a hold.

ops-bot: Audit alert: Support level increased without amendment. Billing hold applied. Ticket TICK-4021 opened.

emma_revenue: Proposed steps: 1) Sales confirm signed amendment (Jorge). 2) Legal confirm whether retroactive billing allowed without signature (Kelly). 3) If no signature, issue credit memo for $40k expansion and revert support to Standard unless customer signs amendment.

jorge_sales: I'm reaching out to MedCore AE now. If they want the expansion charge, we need a signed SOW. I'll request written approval or PO.

kelly_legal: Retroactive billing without signature is risky. Recommend we issue credit unless we obtain signed amendment within 48 hours. Document communication thread.

ben_billing: If credit is approved, I'll prepare CM-2025-011 and corrected invoice INV-2025-0017R. Note for RevOps: ensure revenue recognition for the $40k isn't booked in Feb.

emma_revenue: Finance prefers quick resolution via credit to avoid month-close churn. Jorge please escalate to AE and ask for confirmation whether they want credit applied to current invoice or next renewal.

jorge_sales: AE replied — they did not sign expansion and request credit to current invoice. Also asking for a $3k goodwill credit for incident response in Jan.

kelly_legal: Goodwill credit is fine; document it as non-recurring concession. Recommend cap $5k.

emma_revenue: Ok — total credit $43k. Ben please issue CM-2025-011 for $43,000 and reissue corrected invoice. Jorge to obtain written acceptance email for records.

ben_billing: Will issue CM-2025-011 and INV-2025-0017R today and mark original invoice as disputed.

ops-bot: Actions recorded: TICK-4021 assigned to ben_billing, due 2025-02-03.

emma_revenue: Thanks all — please paste the credit memo and acceptance email when done.
